chunks: 1639 - Al-Ḥalabī narrated from him, peace be upon him:
"Fatimah, peace be upon her, allocated her charities for Banī Hāshim and Banī al-Muṭṭalib."

key_terms.الْحَلَبِيُّ: Al-Ḥalabī, the narrator transmitting the report
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ: Fāṭimah عليها السلام, daughter of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: For whom did Fāṭimah عليها السلام designate her charities?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Fāṭimah عليها السلام designated her charities for Banī Hāshim and Banī al-Muṭṭalib. It indicates a specific allocation of charitable giving within her kinship group and is relevant to discussions of financial law and the distribution of charity.
